stem:
The Venn diagram shows a way to classify shapes.

Polygons

At least one right angle  At least one pair of parallel sides

Select TWO shapes that belong in the shaded region of the Venn diagram.
instruction: Select TWO shapes that belong in the shaded region of the Venn diagram.

options.text: Right triangle with one right angle
Rectangle with four right angles and two pairs of parallel sides
Equilateral triangle with no right angles or parallel sides
Rhombus with no right angles and two pairs of parallel sides
Pentagon with no right angles and no parallel sides
Trapezoid with two right angles and one pair of parallel sides

visual_elements: Venn diagram with two intersecting circles labeled 'At least one right angle' and 'At least one pair of parallel sides' with the overlapping region shaded
Images of six shapes: right triangle with one right angle, rectangle, equilateral triangle, rhombus, pentagon, trapezoid
